description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hanchapala, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510202
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules specifying land parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and property classifications for multiple land parcels in the Gampaha District. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
